headline: Déficit fiscal dominicano supera al de países de Centroamérica
summary: The Dominican Republic projects a 2026 fiscal deficit of 4.2% of GDP, above most Central American countries and near Mexico's level. Energy subsidies and higher international fuel prices are adding budget pressure.
why: Fiscal deficits drive government borrowing and sovereign debt issuance, which affect bond yields and investor appetite for emerging-market debt. Energy subsidies are a key lever in how governments absorb fuel price shocks.
